plugins.name: claude-crew
plugins.description: Tiered Claude delegate agents (scout/reader/implementer) with pinned Haiku/Sonnet/Opus models, so subagent work stops inheriting the expensive session model

plugins.name: codex-crew
plugins.description: Codex (GPT-family) delegate agents with pinned models — implementer lanes (luna/terra/sol) and a read-only reviewer — riding the official Codex plugin's companion runtime, with in-flight job control (steer/queue/redirect), a per-job broker so concurrency never strands a job, per-dispatch reasoning effort on adversarial reviews, and a redacting archive that outlives session cleanup
